- Verify which Azure field seller(s) will be assigned for "Acme Corp / Enterprise" (NAMER).

2) Redwood and Azure field team agree on seller assignment and ownership for the accounts in scope.
3) We'll upload the mapping file into Partner Center and kick off the mutual action plan in HubSpot.

Available for a short sync Tue/Wed next week.
